twist: Took auxility's rigid pixel-perfect column system and converted all column definitions to fractional/percentage units, making the grid fluid and scale-aware. Added a named-area bento grid template not present in source. Removed hardcoded pixel column widths in favor of proportional equivalents. Introduced an asymmetric 3:2 split for editorial sections.

hero-split.description: Asymmetric 3:2 — left holds the primary statement, right holds a secondary visual or annotation panel.

feature-3col.description: Three equal columns for feature/methodology cards.

bento-main.description: Bento grid: primary cell spans 2 rows and 2 columns, two side cells stack vertically.

visual.description: Logo left, nav links center, CTA right — 46px height, 30px item spacing.
Left 3/5: oversized tracked heading at weight 300, single sentence sub. Right 2/5: specimen-label annotation column.
Three method cards with horizontal rule above each, number label, heading, body.
Primary cell spans 2 rows — contains the central product statement. Two side cells stack vertically with complementary details.
Four service category cards in a row.
Single large CTA block, full page width.
